evidence: The sheet delivers the manifesto grammar literally: monumental Ming-style Chinese headline across the upper ivory field, Bodoni 'Dior' mark and sans subtitle stacked beneath, and the untouched J'adore packshot standing small in the lower field with a soft contact shade; glass transmission, gold collar and label are faithfully preserved and the frontal diffuse light agrees with the source. However the single intended visual event misfires: the champagne product_silhouette primitive is placed almost exactly coincident with the packshot bounds, so instead of a legible teardrop contour echoing behind the object only a faint warm crescent peeks around the spherical stopper, reading as a misregistration halo or glow artifact on the cap edge. The typographic confrontation is competent but generic-minimal: left-margin stacked text over a large undifferentiated void, with a dead band between subtitle and bottle, and the SimSun headline at this scale reads as a default system serif rather than a crafted monumental letterform. The copy ('名字先于一切 / 无需多言，一瓶即是全部证明') does articulate the name-before-object proposition, but the visible poster reduces that proposition to prose plus a pasted packshot; comparable reference craft (legacy Dior golden field, 007 floral event) stages a resolved graphic or photographic event, which this sheet lacks.

problems.problem: The declared champagne teardrop echo is not legible as a silhouette; only a faint crescent halo appears around the sphere stopper, reading as an edge artifact rather than the concept's 'only echo of its shape'.
problems.root_cause: background.shapes product_silhouette bounds (409,570,280x755) nearly coincide with the product bounds, so the accent is occluded by the packshot except at the cap, where it reads as a glow.
problems.repair_strategy: Re-place the single product_silhouette primitive offset and enlarged behind the product (e.g. shifted up-left and scaled so a clear teardrop contour band of 40-60px reads around the shoulder and body, not just the cap), keeping opacity ~0.22 champagne and z-order behind the product; keep background prompt as empty ivory paper so no generated contour interferes.

problems.problem: Headline set in default SimSun at monumental scale shows thin, uneven Ming strokes and loose default spacing; the 'Dior' Bodoni mark with heavy tracking floats disconnected between headline and subtitle rather than forming one measured masthead block.
problems.root_cause: Font choice and tracking left at system defaults; logo and subtitle y-positions spaced arbitrarily instead of on a shared baseline grid with the headline.
problems.repair_strategy: Keep the serif family but tighten the masthead: reduce logo tracking to ~2-3, pull logo and subtitle into a consistent left optical margin aligned to the headline's first stroke, and increase subtitle size/leading slightly so the three text layers read as one stacked declaration block; optionally raise headline weight via a heavier serif face if available, without changing palette or composition.

problems.problem: A large empty band between the subtitle (y~470-500) and the bottle cap (y~585) plus the centered bottle under a left-aligned text block leaves the mid-sheet unresolved; the void reads as unused space rather than intentional negative space measuring type against object.
problems.root_cause: Layout relation 'above' executed with centered product and left text without an anchoring axis; no shared vertical rhythm connects declaration and proof.
problems.repair_strategy: Align the product's vertical axis to the headline's optical center or shift the text block to share the bottle's centerline, and tighten the gap so subtitle, silhouette crown and cap form a continuous descent; preserve the small-scale packshot and ivory void per the concept.

problems.problem: The visible sliver of champagne shape around the clear stopper creates a warm ring that conflicts with the stopper's milky white highlights, making the cap edge look dirty or double-exposed at viewing distance.
problems.root_cause: Silhouette accent overlapping the translucent cap region where the source packshot already carries bright opaque white refraction.
problems.repair_strategy: After re-positioning the silhouette per problem 1, verify no champagne band crosses the stopper; if any overlap remains, lower the silhouette's top edge below the cap or reduce opacity so the glass highlights stay clean.

logo_correct.evidence: 'Dior' set in Bodoni serif at left masthead, correctly spelled and consistent with house serif equity seen in the legacy reference.

shape_preserved.evidence: Bottle, ribbed collar, sphere stopper and teardrop body match the untouched packshot contour with no distortion or cropping.

grounding_correct.evidence: Graphic scene_mode: intentional suspended presentation with a soft measured contact shade at the base; no invented floor required.

edges_clean.evidence: Champagne silhouette sliver around the stopper reads as a halo artifact on the cap edge, compromising the perceived cutout cleanliness.

lighting_consistent.evidence: Even diffuse frontal illumination on the packshot is unchanged and matches the flat poster field; no directional shadow conflicts.

text_uncropped.evidence: Headline, logo and subtitle sit fully inside canvas margins with no clipping.

text_collision_free.evidence: No text layer overlaps the product or another text layer; spacing is loose but clear.

fonts_present.evidence: SimSun headline, YaHei subtitle and Bodoni logo all render as specified families in the finished sheet.

brand_spelling_correct.evidence: 'Dior' and on-glass 'j'adore / EAU DE PARFUM / Dior' read correctly.

copy_concept_specific.evidence: '名字先于一切' and '无需多言，一瓶即是全部证明' state the name-before-object declaration and are not interchangeable slogans.

visual_memory_visible.evidence: The intended monumental-type-versus-small-object confrontation is present but the only designed graphic event (the teardrop echo) is invisible as a silhouette; what remains is a competent minimal template plus pasted packshot, below the reference set's resolved events.
